description: A dermatologist-inspired routine for managing and enhancing wavy hair, focusing on hydration, protection, and regular care to maintain healthy, vibrant waves.
frequency: Daily with a weekly deep conditioning treatment

morning_steps.action: Apply lightweight leave-in conditioner or mist
morning_steps.purpose: Hydrate and detangle hair for a smooth texture

night_steps.action: Gently massage shampoo into damp hair focusing on the scalp
night_steps.purpose: Cleanse without stripping natural oils, maintaining hair's moisture balance

night_steps.action: Rinse thoroughly and apply a leave-in conditioner or lightweight serum
night_steps.purpose: Hydrate and nourish the hair overnight, promoting smoothness in the morning

weekly_steps.action: Deep condition with a heat protectant spray or cream

do: Use sulfate-free products to avoid stripping natural oils from the hair
Protect your hair from heat styling tools by applying heat protectants
Regularly trim split ends to maintain hair health and prevent breakage
dont: Overwash or use harsh, drying shampoos that can strip moisture from the hair
Use excessive heat styling tools which can damage the hair cuticle over time
common_mistakes: Using products with heavy oils and waxes during summer months
Failing to protect hair from environmental factors like UV rays and pollution
Neglecting regular trims, leading to split ends and frizz

expected_results.2_weeks: Improved manageability, reduced frizz, enhanced hair shine
expected_results.1_month: Healthier looking waves with less breakage and more definition
expected_results.3_months: Waves are stronger and more defined; overall hair health improved

expert_tips: Consider the humidity levels in your environment to adjust product usage accordingly for best results
Experiment with different hairstyles using clips or headbands to manage waves without damaging the ends of your hair
